_comment: Spawn config for the LABEL-CORPUS collection drive.
WHY A SEPARATE FILE. objects.town01.json declares NO LiDAR at all and
objects.town05.json declares only sensor.lidar.ray_cast. Neither declares a
semantic LiDAR, so /carla/ego_vehicle/semantic_lidar would simply never appear and
the bag would record a topic list with a hole in it.
THE TWO LIDARS MUST MATCH. ray_cast supplies the scan the classifier sees;
ray_cast_semantic supplies the ObjTag ground truth for the enclosure axis. They are
at the same spawn point with the same range, channels, fov and rotation_frequency
so the GT describes the same geometry the scan contains. Diverge them and every
enclosure disagreement is a sensor difference wearing a perception costume.
FOV -12..+12, NOT -26.8..+2.0. The -26.8..+2.0 FOV stares at the road: 30 of 32
beams below horizontal. With upper_fov 2.0 the highest ray reaches only 2.87 m above
the road at 25 m, so a building facade is invisible past that, and the `above-road`
band (+1.49..+3.49 m above ground) is fed by 13 of 32 channels and only 4 at 25 m.
WIDENING IS NOT THE FIX; RETARGETING IS. At a fixed 32 channels, -25..+15 spreads
the beams thinner (1.29 deg vs 0.93) and buys nothing at range. What is wasted is
the bottom: 17 of 32 beams hit tarmac within 10 m. -12..+12 reclaims them, improves
spacing to 0.77 deg, and takes `above-road` from 6 to 15 beams at 10 m and 4 to 6 at
25 m, with no change to channels, points_per_second or bag size.
The cost is deliberate: the road is now only swept out to 9.4 m (2.0/tan(12 deg)).
The 72-bin feature reads structure, not tarmac -- but any check that assumes ground
returns at 25 m has to account for this.
range 50 m, not 30: the classifier crops to its own max_lidar_range anyway, but the
GT wants to see a building before the vehicle is beside it -- `past_building` and
`around_building` are relations over approach and departure, not just abeam.
NO CAMERAS. sensor.lidar.ray_cast is a physics raycast and works with
no_rendering_mode ON; only cameras need the renderer. Leaving them out keeps
rendering off, and nothing in the GT plan consumes an image.
sensor.pseudo.odom is REQUIRED: without odometry there is no pose and no join from
a scan to a region.
10 Hz, not 20: the classifier consumes ~10 Hz and the rate sets the bag size
directly (about 24 MB/s at 20 Hz).
spawn_point is deliberately absent from ego_vehicle: the collection driver sets it
from route.<town>.json, and a hardcoded pose here would silently win.
